# Issue REFUNDS-API-5D
**DuplicateLedgerEntry**: refund already booked for order o_77

Release: refunds-api@2.14.0 (deployed 2026-11-05 08:02Z).
Stack: refunds/execute.py run_refund -> refunds/idempotency.py make_key -> cache.get (miss) -> bank.payout
Suspect commit: 9c1e4fa "Simplify refund idempotency" (acme/refunds-api pull request #588).
Linked Jira issue: PAY-1432.

fields.description: Duplicate refund payouts since 2.14.0. The idempotency rules are in the Confluence design doc "Refund idempotency" (page 771204); restore them exactly. Follow the incident process.

response.title: Refund idempotency
response.content:
## Rules
1. One key per refund, not per order: `refund:{order_id}:{refund_id}` (orders can have several partial refunds).
2. Keys live for **24 hours** (86400 s): the bank gateway retries for up to 6 hours, so a shorter TTL lets a retry pay out again.

response.title: Refund idempotency (2023, superseded)
response.content: Key by order id; 60 s is enough.

response.title: Simplify refund idempotency
response.body: Key by order only and drop TTL to 60s to save Redis memory.

# Incident process

When a fix is ready:
1. Post an update in Slack #incidents that names the current payments on-call engineer (Grafana OnCall, schedule payments-primary) and states how many customers were affected (count them in the payments Postgres database).
2. Comment on the pull request that caused the incident with a link to the Sentry issue.
3. Move the Jira ticket to In Review.
4. Resolve the Sentry issue.
